description: This file defines the 'DeviceCredentials' interface which serves as a wrapper around device authentication credentials, providing methods to retrieve the credential type, authentication ID, and tenant ID.

classes.name: DeviceCredentials
classes.description: An interface representing device credentials for authentication purposes.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of credentials this instance represents.

methods.name: getAuthId
methods.description: Returns the identity that the device wants to authenticate as.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Returns the tenant that the device claims to belong to.
